// Step 7: Automated Student Academic Logger & Email Dispatcher (Simulated) const item = $input.first().json; const emailHtml = `

CodeSense Autonomous AI Student Report

Hello ${item.student_name},

Your recent code submission for ${item.problem_title} (${item.language.toUpperCase()}) was evaluated autonomously.

Autonomy Score: ${item.score}/100

Status: ${item.status}

Autonomy Badge: ${item.evaluation.autonomy_badge}

Core Concept: ${item.evaluation.core_concept}

Guidance: ${item.evaluation.recommended_action}

Generated automatically by CodeSense AI Student Automation Engine (n8n pipeline).

`; return [{ json: { student_email: item.student_email, email_subject: `[CodeSense AI] Your Autonomous Learning Diagnosis: ${item.problem_title}`, email_body_html: emailHtml, database_record_saved: true, status: "SUCCESS", payload: item } }];
